title: The Grading Rubric Database — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Real information from reliable public sources and official catalogs, fact-checked reference. Rubric criteria, performance levels, and assessment guidance. The Grading Rubric Database stores assessment rubrics as structured records: each criterion, the performance levels per criterion, point values, and what distinguishes each level. Students use rubrics to self-score drafts before submission; instructors use them as transparent grading contracts. The Signature side adds self-scoring worksheets that walk students through applying each criterion.
capabilities: Model rubrics as criteria with leveled performance descriptions
Attach point values and weights to every criterion
Provide self-scoring worksheets for draft review
Compare rubric expectations across similar assignments
Export rubrics as printable grading sheets
